About

Hi, I’m Ahmed

I’m a senior at Somers High School in New York. I play varsity football, I like building things, and I’m learning how AI agents work so I can show other people how to build them.

I like working on a team, whether that’s football, FIRST LEGO League robotics, coaching a Destination Imagination team, or a hackathon at NYU Abu Dhabi. I want to study computer science and computer engineering. I like taking an idea and turning it into something that works, then showing other people how it works.

Football

On the field

I play varsity football for Somers High School, and our team has been ranked number one so far this season. Football taught me that a team only works when everyone shows up. I try to do the same everywhere else.

Somers “remains in the top spot” in the lohud Section 1 football Top 10 rankings, as of late October 2026.

Reading

Books and anime on my shelf

I read mostly fantasy and manga and I watch a lot of anime. These are a few that stuck with me.

Chainsaw ManNarutoPercy JacksonHarry PotterLord of MysteriesHaikyu!!Dr. StoneBlue LockMy Hero AcademiaFullmetal AlchemistHunter x Hunter

Lord of Mysteries

Klein, the main character, has to play a role to get stronger, but if he plays it for too long he starts to lose himself. I think about that a lot. It’s easy to act the way people expect, and harder to stay yourself.

Naruto

Naruto isn’t the most talented kid, but he keeps training and he keeps showing up for his friends. That’s what I like about him.

Chainsaw Man

It’s dark and weird, and I never know what’s coming next. Underneath that, it’s about what regular people want and how far they’ll go to get it.

Percy Jackson

An ordinary kid finds out he belongs to a much bigger world. It’s funny, and the friendships carry the story.

Harry Potter

A group of friends who keep showing up for each other when things get hard.

Haikyu!!

A small volleyball team that wins by trusting each other and practicing the basics. It reminds me of football, where every position matters.

Dr. Stone

Science and engineering rebuild a whole world from nothing. I like that the hero solves problems by figuring out how things work.

Blue Lock

A sports story about wanting to be the best while still needing a team. I think about that balance on the field.

My Hero Academia

A kid with no advantage works harder than anyone and earns his place. It’s about effort more than talent.

Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood

Two brothers learn that shortcuts have a price. It makes you think about responsibility.

Hunter x Hunter

Gon keeps going because he is curious and loyal to his friends, and the clever fights make me think.

Travel

Places I’ve been

I like seeing how other people live. So far I’ve been to the UAE, Saudi Arabia (Mecca and Riyadh), Morocco, Canada and Florida.

Every place I’ve visited has its own character, and each one shows how people have built and adapted over time. The detailed patterns in Fes and across Morocco carry centuries of history in their tiles and carved doors. The deserts of Saudi Arabia and the UAE show how people and nature keep going in harsh heat and sand. In Dubai, the towers and the Burj Khalifa show how far architecture has come. Seeing all of this, I learned that every culture and every place has something worth respecting, and that people do best when they let those differences make them stronger. I want to carry that into the things I build.
